core_claim: Audient's third-generation iD interfaces add RoomTune monitor correction and onboard DSP effects.
topic: How Audient's third-generation iD interfaces measure room acoustics, adjust monitor playback, and run input effects through onboard DSP.
title: Can Your Room Trick Your Violin Mix?
hook: Could your room change your violin mix?
description: Audient's third-generation iD interfaces add RoomTune monitor correction. The system measures room acoustics and adjusts the signal sent to studio monitors. The onboard DSP also runs EQ, compression and reverb on input signals without latency. This Short illustrates monitor correction and input processing, not a claim that the original violin recording is rewritten.
cover_payoff: Use the separately licensed violin and bow geometry selected for this story. Animate a symbolic bow stroke across the strings and use a sampled violin phrase as illustrative accompaniment. Never present the sample as Prince's live performance. Show the correction signal path around monitor playback, not as a change to the recorded violin take.
narration_script: Could your room change your violin mix? Audient adds RoomTune monitor correction to its new iD interfaces. It measures your room and adjusts the signal reaching your monitors. Its onboard DSP also runs EQ, compression and reverb with no latency.

narration_evidence.quote: analogue mic preamps with onboard DSP, monitor correction and new tone-shaping tools.
It measures your room and adjusts the signal going to your monitors to compensate for its acoustics
The DSP also handles EQ, compression and reverb on the inputs with no latency and no load on your computer.

sources.title: "This isn't a spec refresh – it's a completely new technology platform": Audient launches next generation of iD audio interfaces with onboard DSP and built-in monitor correction
